pathAssistantSteps.info:
Use Secure a Trial if we have not already won the trial

Once liners are delivered we should create a new Opportunity for their replacement.

If the set delivered is a spare set, ie not for the next reline, following the sales process for the set going in (which should lead to the next spare set).

Make sure someone, usually the account owner, is assigned to attend the installation and available for interim measurements.

Best practice is to create a Tasks for the assigned these resources (even if it is yourself).

Close the stage when you are comfortable the product has the required technical support to be successful for its expected lifespan.

Close the stage at any point during the process when the customer withdraws or purchases from an alternative supplier.

Remember, an Opportunity is for a particular reline: if we miss that reline the Opportunity is lost. If you believe the customer may still be interested in sourcing from ME Elecmetal then a new Opportunity for a future reline should be created.
Close the stage when the product is shipped and invoice is raised.

Review pricing level. Consider whether costs have changed; supply-demand dynamics have changed; how much value have we demonstrated.

Review pricing method. Would the customer prefer a risk sharing model eg $ per week or $ per tonne processed ore.

Include accessories in the commercial proposal.

Ensure freight is taken into account and we recover costs.

Ensure GST is covered.

Get sign off from MD, ME Elecmetal APAC (note: include proposed price versus alternatives not just price vs costs)

Always accompany a commercial proposal with a meeting or phone call.

Close the stage when the commercial proposal is presented to the customer

Refers to installation of previously sold trial liners in the "Secure A Trial" opportunity (not the liners we are trying to win going forward)

Ensure the liners are installed as specified eg bolt tension.

Close the stage when the liners / media are installed.

Establish a schedule of site and/or corporate visits.

Australia has a scanner available on both the East and West coast.

Both Chile and USA teams can do the wear reports for us; Chile's tend to be preferred.

Turn data into insight and recommendations.

Close the stage when you have enough data and interactions to be in a position to propose a technical solution for the replacement set

Raise a House Order Form (HOF) based on the PO.

Ensure the foundry inform you of the outcome from the first article trial.

Keep track of progress through manufacturing process (a production meeting with China is held every Friday at 11am AEST.

Keep the customer informed of progress.

Ensure the invoice is in line with the PO to ensure on time payment.

Close the stage when the product is shipped and invoice is raised.

(Remember to open a new Opportunity for the replacement liners)

Ask for the Purchase Order (PO).

Revisit technical and / or commercial proposal is required.

Close the stage when the PO is received.

Start early so decisions are made without time constraints

Make sure you understand the customer's future requirements eg is the ore changing, is there a major operation change planned.

Use the information gathered during the current campaign.

Involve the customer in the thinking.

Reach out to ME Elecmetal's experts around the globe for ideas.

When you have a proposed solution raise an Engineering Change Order (ECO) with the Technical Design team.

Always look for improvement: it is critical to who we are.

Close the stage when the customer has accepted the proposed technical solution.
